faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Range Rover Sport TDV8 use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year. From 2005 to 2013 (L320 generation), the Range Rover Sport TDV8 used the TDV8 4.4-litre V8 diesel. From 2013 to 2022 (L494), it switched to the SDV8 4.4-litre V8 diesel — a later, more powerful evolution of the same engine family.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Range Rover Sport TDV8 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £4,500, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover Sport TDV8?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the TDV8 or the SDV8 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild TDV8 Range Rover Sport engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every TDV8 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild SDV8 Range Rover Sport engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The SDV8 is a later iteration of the V8 diesel, and we service it to the same high standard as the TDV8, addressing its common timing chain and injector wear patterns.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Range Rover Sport TDV8 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Range Rover Sport TDV8 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Range Rover Sport TDV8 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Range Rover Sport TDV8 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
